About Kestrel Remit

Kestrel Remit Ltd is a London money-transfer app that lets people in the UK send money to Poland, Romania and Lithuania. Authorised by the UK Financial Conduct Authority as a payment institution. Fees from GBP 0.99 per transfer.

Payment institutions

A firm that provides payment services, including money remittance, in Ireland must be authorised by the Central Bank of Ireland as a payment institution under the European Union (Payment Services) Regulations 2018, unless it is authorised in another EEA member state and has passported its services into Ireland. Firms authorised in the United Kingdom can no longer passport into Ireland. Applicants should engage with the Central Bank before submitting an application; the assessment period depends on the quality and completeness of the application.
